description: Ask the running server to restart: it pauses dispatch while keeping intake and cloud sync available, lets running jobs finish for up to wait_seconds (default 30), then exits only if idle. On timeout it resumes dispatch without terminating jobs; `force: true` terminates them. Launchd / systemd starts it again after an exit. Only works for a server run as the service (409 otherwise); use it after update_config changed host or port, or after an update was installed.
name: restart_server
title: Restart server
